operating_model: bounded local automation; no unattended LLM claims

work_packages.name: Canonical integration refresh
work_packages.scope: Inspect newer GitHub main records and produce a source-drift report; never silently replace pinned canon.

work_packages.name: World route and travel graph
work_packages.scope: Compile canonical region and location adjacency into validated navigation records; no invented metric routes.

work_packages.name: Regional visual palettes
work_packages.scope: Develop source-based material and biome references for all 7 zones, preserving provenance.

work_packages.name: Region construction kits
work_packages.scope: Implement modular generated landscape proxy components and build scripts in UE; verify idempotency.

work_packages.name: Playable first vertical slice
work_packages.scope: Add collision, spawn, navigation and editor-level Play verification with FPS and memory evidence.

work_packages.name: Preview camera and render
work_packages.scope: Create actual Sequencer camera shots and save inspectable image frames on the Mac.

work_packages.name: Location-scale rollout
work_packages.scope: Rebuild all source-approved locations through reusable kits; separately flag provisional/interpretive records.

work_packages.name: Historic event overlays
work_packages.scope: Replay verified source events without canon writeback; preserve venue and chronology.

work_packages.name: Character source gate
work_packages.scope: Check visual asset hash and subject binding; HOLD if not proven.

work_packages.name: Integration and release QA
work_packages.scope: Run full repo CI, independent Umpire evidence review, decide merge only when genuinely green.
